How to Book Your Stay on Cleartrip?
Follow these simple steps for a quick and easy hotel booking:
Enter your destination, dates, and guest details.
Use filters to sort by price, reviews, or amenities.
Choose a property that meets your needs.
Finalise your reservation by adding guest details and making a payment.
Receive an instant booking confirmation through email.
What types of hotels are available on Cleartrip?
We provide options ranging from luxury hotels and boutique stays to budget-friendly hotels and family-friendly properties.
How do I book a hotel on Cleartrip?
Search your destination, select your dates, and browse available options. Complete your hotel booking in just a few simple steps on Cleartrip.
Are there discounts on hotel bookings?
Yes, Cleartrip offers exclusive discounts, deals, and cashback options on select properties.
Can I modify or cancel my hotel reservation?
Depending on the hotel’s cancellation policy, you can adjust or cancel your booking. Review the terms before completing the reservation.
Are the hotel prices displayed per person or room?
We typically list prices per room unless stated otherwise. Review the total cost of your stay at checkout.
Do I need to pay in advance for the hotel reservation?
Some hotels require advance payment, while others allow pay-at-check-in options. We will share the payment policy during the booking process.
Can I book a hotel for someone else?
Yes, simply provide their details during booking, and they can check in using the confirmation.
Is breakfast included in my hotel stay?
Many hotels offer complimentary breakfast. Filter your search to find options with this feature or check hotel details.

Hotel amenities, rates, and policies may change based on availability or the time of booking. Always confirm specific details such as cancellation policies, additional charges, or special requirements directly with the hotel before completing your reservation.
